um 60 62 you said I thought I thought I

but but it's not as much as men

it it can't be so difficult and I think
I think financial literacy is is a life

what what we're doing with what we have
um so I think I think financial
independence is very important and we
need to
uh to I guess it's it's not on anyone's

choose their family or whatever it is

education policy? I I'm not sure I'm the
